kept.spine: A traveller off the road reads Rundgate's standing before a word is spoken to him. The spread of trades keeps more hands at work than the town strictly needs, and the traffic itself keeps an easy pace.

kept.poolKey: TRADE PROFILE: exports and imports both present
kept.spine: The market here carries Rundgate's own goods beside other towns' goods, unsorted for any stranger who cannot tell the difference.
The yards stand full of goods bound outward, and no two loads are alike. This is a place built on selling.
Here the count comes out ahead by a little, season after season.
The town keeps its Garrison fed by a supply that failed somewhere upstream. The building stands, the skill remains, and the accounts wait.
A little of the trade here slips by unrecorded... small enough that the clerks shrug at it and turn their attention elsewhere.
